plugins.name: issue-evaluator
plugins.description: Evaluate GitHub issues against the current repo: diagnose, check fix status, analyze code style, provide reproduction and fix plans, implement fixes with optional implementation tournament, review pull requests, scan for high-value issues, and run runtime-aware adversarial review after fixing.

plugins.name: worktree-cleaner
plugins.description: Clean up git worktrees whose branches have merged/closed PRs, with optional removal of no-PR worktrees.

plugins.name: harness-engineering
plugins.description: Design, audit, harden, and run the scaffolding around autonomous agents — the harness that constrains inputs, externalizes state, verifies every step, and recovers from failure. Commands: /harness-design, /harness-audit, /sprint-contract, /resilience-plan, /goal-mode.

plugins.name: idea-to-ship
plugins.description: End-to-end flow from a vague idea to shipped code: requirement mining, commercialization scenarios, UI/UX design contracts, architecture design, evidence-backed roadmap planning, adversarial design review, TDD-gated implementation, traceability-aware code review, and story-driven test strategy. Each stage lands a markdown artifact under .idea-to-ship/ so stages compose and can resume.

plugins.name: auto-updater
plugins.description: SessionStart hook that refreshes Claude and Codex plugins installed from local directory marketplaces when their source environment is available.

plugins.name: agent-playbook
plugins.description: Operator-facing distillation of the best-practice literature (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Anthropic engineering, Peter Steinberger). Commands: /workflow-router, /bootstrap-project-memory, /context-audit, /vibe-coding-health-check, /vibe-coding-fix, /implementation-tournament, /tool-review, /commit-changes.

plugins.name: secret-scanner
plugins.description: Scan staged/uncommitted/recent changes for leaked secrets - cloud keys (AWS, Google), VCS tokens (GitHub, GitLab), AI API keys (OpenAI, Anthropic), payment keys (Stripe), Slack/Twilio/SendGrid tokens, JWTs, private keys, DB connection strings, and generic password/token assignments. Deterministic Python scanner plus LLM-assisted false-positive triage. Read-only.

plugins.name: skill-stats
plugins.description: Track skill invocations, display usage statistics, and optionally run report-only skill-cleaner analysis with explicit apply-confirm cleanup.

plugins.name: antifragile
plugins.description: Antifragility audits. /antifragile-agent checks plugin/hook/skill robustness; /antifragile-system checks the target project for resilience gaps (dependency fallbacks, error handling, single points of failure, data safety, observability).
